card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS headings and warnings
card.fires_on: Pieces of words and small linking words inside ALL-CAPS text, such as section headings, boxed warnings and table headers in drug labels. It fires while the capitalised phrase is still unfinished.

modes.label: Split capitalised words
modes.description: Partway through a long medical word written in capitals, such as CLINICAL, CARDIAC, HEART or TISSUE.

modes.label: Linking words in capital headings
modes.description: Small words like AND or OF inside an all-caps heading or instruction.
modes.example: 10 SKIN<< AND>> SKIN STRUCTURE Uncomplicated Skin

card.writes: It promotes capitalised small words such as IS, ON, AS, IF, TO, so the text stays in capitals.
card.plain: It marks that the text is in all capitals and helps the model carry on in capitals.
